articles.fullText: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA French companies are putting NVIDIA infrastructure and open models to work across all industries, from satellites in orbit to cosmetics in corner stores. October 12, 2026 by Nat Ives 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements   Sovereign AI Infrastructure France-based companies are expanding agentic infrastructure on NVIDIA technology. Bull is extending its European AI server production to NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72 systems, planned for 2028, with trays produced in Europe and rack integration at its Angers factory — inaugurated Friday, Oct. 2. Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit. Integrated by Loft Orbital and built in Abu Dhabi by Orbitworks , a joint venture between Loft Orbital and Marlan Space , the satellite is flying NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge modules, running Mistral’s models, for real-time Earth observation and autonomous operations in orbit. Open Models NVIDIA Nemotron open models are in production across French organizations that require sovereign, trustworthy data. LINAGORA and Docaposte have secured the CANUT framework agreement , making Twake.ai, built on NVIDIA Nemotron, the sole referenced sovereign digital workplace for more than 2,500 French public organizations. In financial services, SBS is launching a sovereign platform enabling banks to deploy governed generative and agentic services within their own environments, in collaboration with NVIDIA. Last week, Mistral introduced under private preview Mistral Large 4 open model, with state-of-the-art, open weight performance in cyber defense, manufacturing, finance and multimodal tasks, and a solid foundation for customizing models across key industries. Fondation Inria , with NVIDIA’s support, is launching a working group on open source advanced modeling and tool adoption, with findings to come in the spring of next year. Agents at Work Across Industries Across retail, public services, telecommunications and science, the pattern is consistent: open models and NVIDIA infrastructure are driving results in France. L’Oréal is integrating NVIDIA ALCHEMI into its research workflows so scientists can explore formulation possibilities in silico and better help guide laboratory research. Combining computational predictions with hands-on experimentation can make the discovery process up to 100x faster than traditional methods and maximize the potential of the group’s proprietary active ingredients. Mirakl has onboarded more than 70 million products with fine-tuned and open models running on NVIDIA GPUs and inference software, cutting seller catalog onboarding to under two hours. Photoroom and Vestiaire Collective a re demonstrating the measurable business impact of advanced visual modeling on marketplace performance. Omi helps brands bring accurate products into AI-generated marketing visuals at scale, combining its approved 3D digital twins with open models optimized on NVIDIA for 4x faster inference. In Côte-d’Or, ThinkDeep and Akila built a digital-twin agent — powered by NVIDIA Cosmos open world models, Nemotron and Omniverse libraries — managing nearly 5,800 kilometers of roads and buildings, cutting total operating costs by 10% and targeting 30% as deployment progresses. Port Sud de France runs goods processing and port security on ThinkDeep’s DeepBrain platform powered by Nemotron and Cosmos. Enchanted Tools, a robotics company headquartered in Paris, is deploying social robots to support patients in healthcare settings including pediatric cancer care. In telecom, Bouygues Telecom and Prisme.ai have launched AI Studio V2, powered by NVIDIA full-stack infrastructure, to offer all of its employees the ability to build their own agents, securely and in a controlled environment In quantum, Alice & Bob has integrated the NVIDIA NVQLink platform for its superconducting cat qubits, showing how GPUs can make quantum error correction more efficient, including for faster qubit modalities. Quandela has also been using NVQLink to build an integration between a DGX Spark system and its photonic qubits — advancing QPU-GPU supercomputing and exploring hybrid quantum-classical applications. Tune in to NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s GTC Berlin keynote on Wednesday, Oct. 21, at 11 a.m.

articles.fullText: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide Cisco, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Visionbay are joining many making advances with Vera Rubin. October 12, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI factories grow from megawatts to gigawatts, building them takes more than advanced computing. Open standards are helping the industry scale AI infrastructure faster, more efficiently and more reliably. At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at creating a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure. NVIDIA contributed key NVIDIA Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to OCP through the open NVIDIA MGX architecture, giving system builders a common foundation for developing next-generation AI factory infrastructure. Together, these efforts span the AI factory itself, the utility grid that powers it and the rack-scale architecture at the heart of modern accelerated computing. NVIDIA and Partners Announce Open Architecture Advances At the OCP event, NVIDIA and partners made a handful of announcements: NVIDIA and hyperscalers published open standards for next-generation AI factories, including AI factory design standards and grid resilience. NVIDIA launched new open source software components for NVIDIA DSX AI Factory. Meta and NVIDIA advanced open AI networking with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet SuperNIC and Spectrum-6 innovations. Visionbay introduced an 800V DC AI factory design for the Vera Rubin era. NVIDIA and Cisco announced the Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP) standard, the industry’s first module ​for 400Gb/s-based networking fabrics. NVIDIA and Google announced Falcon Transport support on future NVIDIA ConnectX-10 SuperNICs and BlueField DPUs. Before a packed audience, Ian Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA, discussed how open infrastructure is becoming a critical ingredient for scaling AI factories worldwide. The news at OCP spotlights how NVIDIA’s extreme codesign combined with open standards is accelerating deployment, improving power efficiency and driving tokens-per-watt performance.   Vera Rubin AI Factories Advance With MGX Rack Contributions at OCP 🔗 NVIDIA joined industry leaders in contributing to the third-generation MGX AI data center reference design through OCP’s Open DC Initiative. Combined with open liquid-cooling technologies such as MQD and MQDB, the effort helps turn proven AI factory designs into industry standards that others can adopt, manufacture and scale. For NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI factories, the updated MGX 1.2 specification extends the open architecture for AI factories with rack-scale blind-mate liquid cooling, interoperable rack-scale interconnect infrastructure and a liquid-cooled 5,000A busbar designed for higher-power AI systems. It also adds native 19-inch equipment support and higher-density rack designs. MGX 1.2 further expands modularity with configurable I/O bays, fanless liquid-cooled compute trays, standardized power and cooling interfaces, and a common infrastructure that helps ecosystem partners build interoperable accelerated computing platforms. It improves assembly, test and service times to streamline manufacturing and field service to enable faster and more efficient infrastructure buildout. The architecture supports rack deployments up to 250kW while simplifying serviceability, deployment and infrastructure reuse. The Vera CPU rack design specification extends the NVIDIA MGX open architecture beyond accelerated computing, providing a purpose-built platform for the growing agentic AI era. While Vera Rubin NVL72 serves as the foundation for large-scale training and inference, the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack is designed to support tool calling, orchestration and sandboxed execution, helping AI agents interact with applications, data and services in real time. Built on the third-generation NVIDIA MGX rack architecture, the Vera CPU rack shares the same rack-scale design principles that unite compute, networking, power and cooling into a common modular platform. This approach enables partners to deploy specialized infrastructure while benefiting from a shared ecosystem, simplified integration and a consistent foundation for next-generation AI factories.   NVIDIA Launches New Open Source Software Components for DSX AI Factory 🔗 NVIDIA DSX AI factory platform applies extreme codesign to unify computing, networking, power, cooling, facilities and software, helping AI factories operate as a single optimized system, maximizing AI output within available infrastructure constraints. articles.title: NVIDIA and Cisco Introduce New Pluggable Optics Form Factor to Scale AI Factories
articles.summary: NVIDIA and Cisco today announced plans for Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a new high-density 400Gb/s-per-lane optical module designed to equip the hardware ecosystem for the next generation of AI factories using pluggable transceivers.
articles.fullText: News Summary: Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP) is designed to be the first module to support 400Gb/s-per-lane electrical signals, enabling capacity up to 12.8Tb/s so AI factory builders can scale Ethernet AI fabrics, while extending a proven deployment model across multiple generations of data center networks. USFP delivers 4x the bandwidth density and 1.3x the power efficiency of 200Gb/s-per-lane optics so AI factories can connect more computing systems without adding network tiers, while using less power to move each bit of data. NVIDIA and Cisco are working with TE Connectivity and Amphenol to build a multi-source hardware ecosystem around USFP.   NVIDIA and Cisco today announced plans for Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a new high-density 400Gb/s-per-lane optical module designed to equip the hardware ecosystem for the next generation of AI factories using pluggable transceivers. As AI models grow and inference demand expands, AI factories must connect more computing systems while managing network complexity, power and costs. Moving more data per watt and per switch helps operators make better use of their infrastructure investments. Scaling AI factories requires more bandwidth per connection and more connections per switch. When a switch reaches its capacity, further network expansion can require additional switch layers and optical links, increasing latency, power consumption and costs. USFP is designed to enable AI factory builders to scale from 200 Gb/s per lane to 400Gb/s-per-lane Ethernet AI fabrics, while extending a deployment model proven at scale across multiple generations of data center networks. With USFP, customers can embrace next-generation optical technology and meet the performance demand of AI workloads without overhauling their data center infrastructure. The first planned USFP-based transceivers will pack 16 full-duplex lanes in an octal small form factor (OSFP)-sized footprint supporting both switches and SuperNICs, with the ability to expand to 32 and more lanes in the future. By doubling both the lane count and bandwidth per lane, USFP enables AI fabrics to connect more 1.6Tb/s endpoints without adding network tiers. Customers will be able to achieve 12.8Tb/s of overall capacity with USFP. Comparable with an OSFP-sized module, it delivers 4x the bandwidth and front-panel bandwidth density, with approximately 1.3x the power efficiency, versus 200Gb/s-per-lane pluggable modules. This means AI builders can increase their compute scale within the same network footprint, while decreasing networking’s share of the overall AI factory power budget. “Building the world’s largest AI factories starts with rethinking the smallest of connections,” said Gilad Shainer, senior vice president NVIDIA. “With USFP, NVIDIA and Cisco are building an ecosystem to reinvent pluggable optics — connecting more computing with greater efficiency to power the next generation of AI factories.” “AI builders need an interconnect architecture that can scale performance without locking them into a more complex operating model,” said Bill Gartner, senior vice president and general manager of optical systems and optics at Cisco. “Cisco and NVIDIA recognized that scaling pluggable optics to 400Gb/s per lane would require more than another incremental extension of today’s module designs. Through our collaboration, USFP is designed to deliver a new level of bandwidth density while preserving the serviceability, deployment flexibility and operational simplicity of pluggable optics. By taking a full-stack approach — from silicon and systems to optics and the network operating system — we can optimize every layer to deliver the performance and scale the next generation of AI networks will require.” More AI Infrastructure From Every Switch Designed for electrical signals of 400Gb/s per lane, USFP uses a new two-dimensional array connector with a two-step insertion design that engages high-speed contacts after the module is inserted, reducing contact wear, improving signal integrity and making insertion force more predictable. The connector technology allows for further scaling of lane count to 32 full duplex lanes and more in the future. Because the connector is designed for 400Gb/s performance, it also offers improved performance at 200Gb/s per lane. USFP supports power dissipation of up to 100 watts without needing a separate, dedicated embedded cooling circuit within the transceiver, reducing switch design complexity and improving reliability. Together, these capabilities enable higher-bandwidth fabrics while preserving the mature deployment, serviceability and manufacturability of existing pluggable transceivers. By taking a full-stack approach — from silicon and systems to optics and the network operating system — we can optimize every layer to deliver the performance and scale the next generation of AI networks will require.” More AI Infrastructure From Every Switch Designed for electrical signals of 400Gb/s per lane, USFP uses a new two-dimensional array connector with a two-step insertion design that engages high-speed contacts after the module is inserted, reducing contact wear, improving signal integrity and making insertion force more predictable. The connector technology allows for further scaling of lane count to 32 full duplex lanes and more in the future. Because the connector is designed for 400Gb/s performance, it also offers improved performance at 200Gb/s per lane. USFP supports power dissipation of up to 100 watts without needing a separate, dedicated embedded cooling circuit within the transceiver, reducing switch design complexity and improving reliability. Together, these capabilities enable higher-bandwidth fabrics while preserving the mature deployment, serviceability and manufacturability of existing pluggable transceivers. All USFP configurations support optical designs that reduce latency and power consumption by simplifying signal processing. Support for a broad range of optical technologies and connection dist
leadArticles.fullSummary: News Summary: Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP) is designed to be the first module to support 400Gb/s-per-lane electrical signals, enabling capacity up to 12.8Tb/s so AI factory builders can scale Ethernet AI fabrics, while extending a proven deployment model across multiple generations of data center networks. USFP delivers 4x the bandwidth density and 1.3x the power efficiency of 200Gb/s-per-lane optics so AI factories can connect more computing systems without adding network tiers, while using less power to move each bit of data. policyIdeas.title: 투자위축 대응형 구매확약·스케일업 보증
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 비R&D 금융·판로 사업으로 구매확약, 보증, 레퍼런스 확보를 묶어 민간 투자 공백을 완화
policyIdeas.why: AI·반도체 주가 변동성이 커지면 비상장 팹리스의 투자 유치와 고객 PoC가 동시에 지연될 수 있습니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 구매확약 금액, 보증 연계 금액, 후속 투자 유치, 고용 유지

policyIdeas.title: 국산 NPU 수요연계 실증·구매전환 바우처
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 비R&D 성격으로 수요기관의 PoC 비용, 클라우드 전환비, 성능검증, 초기 구매비를 패키지로 지원
policyIdeas.why: 국내 NPU 기업은 기술개발 이후 레퍼런스, 구매사례, 운영검증이 부족해 매출 전환이 지연됩니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 유료 전환 PoC 수, 구매계약 금액, 국산 NPU 사용 시간, 고객 재구매율

policyIdeas.title: AI 서비스 기업·NPU 기업 매칭형 마켓플레이스
policyIdeas.budgetItem: AI 서비스·SaaS·SI 기업이 국산 NPU에서 모델을 시험하고 견적을 비교할 수 있는 중개 플랫폼 운영
policyIdeas.why: 비R&D 사업은 기술 자체보다 수요 발굴과 거래비용 절감이 중요합니다. 시장 접점을 만들면 기업 간 매칭 속도가 올라갑니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 등록 수요기업 수, 매칭 건수, PoC 전환율, 상용 계약 전환율

policyIdeas.title: 국산 AI컴퓨팅 성능·전력 검증 인증제
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 민간 시험기관과 연계해 추론 성능, 전력효율, 호환성, 보안성을 검증하고 인증마크를 부여
policyIdeas.why: 구매자는 칩 홍보자료보다 제3자 검증 데이터를 요구합니다. 인증 체계는 조달·금융·해외진출의 공통 근거가 됩니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 인증 제품 수, 공개 벤치마크 수, 조달 등록 건수, 인증 기반 계약 금액

policyIdeas.title: K-엔비디아 기업 공동 데모룸·상설 쇼케이스
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 5개 NPU 기업의 제품을 공공·민간 수요자가 직접 비교 체험할 수 있는 상설 데모룸과 온라인 쇼케이스 운영
policyIdeas.why: 비R&D 사업은 수요자가 실제 성능과 적용 시나리오를 이해하도록 만드는 접점이 중요합니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 방문 수요기관 수, 데모 신청 건수, 후속 상담 건수, PoC 전환율

policyIdeas.title: 국산 NPU 도입 컨설팅·전환 설계 지원단
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 수요기업의 기존 GPU 워크로드를 진단하고 국산 NPU 적용 가능성, 비용, 전력, 전환 일정을 설계해주는 컨설팅 지원
policyIdeas.why: 수요기업은 국산 NPU를 쓰고 싶어도 모델 변환, 운영비 비교, 리스크 판단을 자체적으로 하기 어렵습니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 전환진단 보고서 수, 전환 가능 워크로드 수, 실제 PoC 착수율, 예상 비용 절감액

policyIdeas.title: AI반도체 현장전문인력 전환 교육
policyIdeas.budgetItem: AI 서비스 개발자, MLOps 담당자, 공공 정보화 담당자를 대상으로 NPU 모델 최적화·운영 교육 제공
policyIdeas.why: 칩 도입은 하드웨어 구매만으로 끝나지 않고 운영인력이 있어야 반복 사용과 확산이 가능합니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 교육 수료자 수, 기업별 적용 프로젝트 수, 모델 변환 성공률, 교육 후 PoC 착수율

policyIdeas.title: 온디바이스 AI 실증처 발굴 프로그램
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 제조, 보안, 모빌리티, 의료기기 분야에서 국산 NPU 모듈을 적용할 수요처를 발굴하고 실증 운영비 지원
policyIdeas.why: 데이터 외부 전송이 어렵거나 저전력이 중요한 분야는 국산 NPU가 차별화될 수 있는 초기 시장입니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 실증처 수, 제품 탑재 건수, 지연시간 개선, 전력 절감률

policyIdeas.title: 국산 NPU 기반 AI 데이터센터 전력절감 실증
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 공공·민간 데이터센터 일부 워크로드를 국산 NPU로 이전해 전력, 냉각, 비용 절감 효과를 검증
policyIdeas.why: AI 인프라 비용과 전력 문제가 커질수록 GPU 대체·보완재로서 국산 NPU의 정책 명분이 커집니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 전력 절감률, 랙당 처리량, 운영비 절감액, 전환 대상 워크로드 수

policyIdeas.title: 공공 AI서비스 국산 NPU 우선 실증 트랙
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 민원, 문서요약, 보안관제, 제조안전 등 공공 AI서비스에 국산 NPU 적용 가능성을 평가하는 운영비 지원
policyIdeas.why: 공공 부문은 초기 레퍼런스 시장을 열 수 있습니다. 단순 R&D 과제가 아니라 운영 워크로드 확보에 초점을 둬야 합니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 공공 워크로드 수, 서비스 가동률, 비용 절감률, GPU 대비 전력 절감률

review.headline: 수출통제·AI컴퓨팅 안보, AI 인프라 투자, 추론비용·전력효율 신호를 중심으로, 신규 예산은 기술개발보다 수요 검증·운영 데이터·조달 전환을 강화하는 방향이 적절합니다.

sections.title: 정책수립 시사점
sections.body: 수출통제와 AI컴퓨팅 안보 신호가 강하면 국산 NPU 정책의 논리는 산업육성만이 아니라 안정적 조달과 국가 통제 가능한 AI 인프라 확보로 확장됩니다.
bullets: 해외 GPU 접근 리스크를 국산 AI컴퓨팅 도입 명분으로 정리
수출통제 대응 컨설팅과 조달 카탈로그를 함께 설계

sections.title: 시장·기술동향 판단
sections.body: AI 인프라 투자 확대와 공급망 재편은 국산 NPU에 기회지만, 실제 도입은 성능·전력·가격·운영 안정성 비교자료가 있어야 가능합니다.
bullets: 데이터센터 전력비와 추론비용 절감은 가장 설득력 있는 시장 진입 논리
온디바이스AI와 보안·금융 등 폐쇄망 수요는 해외 GPU 대비 차별화 가능성이 큼
파운드리·공급망 이슈는 국산 NPU 정책의 필요조건이지만, 구매전환을 보장하지는 않음

sections.title: 정부정책 방향
sections.body: 정부정책은 대체 컴퓨팅 확보와 보안검증을 묶어야 합니다. 단순 장비지원보다 공공기관이 실제로 사용할 수 있는 조달·보안·운영 기준을 만드는 것이 우선입니다.
bullets: 공공 폐쇄망 AI서비스 실증 트랙 신설
국산 NPU 보안성·공급 안정성 검증 리포트 발급
수출통제 리스크 진단과 대체 도입계획 컨설팅 지원

sections.title: 예산기획 체크포인트
sections.body: 우선 검토할 정책 아이템은 "투자위축 대응형 구매확약·스케일업 보증"입니다. 신규 예산은 제품 개발비보다 수요처 발굴, 실증 운영비, 성능검증, 구매전환 조건을 묶는 방향이 적합합니다.
bullets: 기업별 제품성숙도, 적용 가능 워크로드, 목표 수요처를 표준 양식으로 비교
시장 기사에서 반복되는 수요 분야를 공공 실증 후보 업무로 매핑
사업 공고에는 성능검증, 보안검증, 가격비교, 구매전환 조건을 필수 항목으로 포함
